title: Synthetic Cyber Evidence and Proposal Workbench
description: Offline, synthetic-only investigation and reviewed handoff. No execution adapter, scanner, identity provider or network connection. Controls and answers are planning-defined examples, not approved STIG content.

components.label: Analyst workbench
components.description: Responsive evidence, findings, proposal review and export panels with accessible native controls.

components.label: Synthetic evidence and baseline
components.description: Inline versioned baseline and seeded/benign/unknown examples, with timestamps and exact excerpts. No official control content.

components.label: Evidence validation and explanation
components.description: Shared dependency-free deterministic validation, applicability and citation-backed findings. No model inference or severity invention.

components.label: Revision-bound proposal review
components.description: Draft/committed distinction, canonical proposal digest, explicit synthetic reviewer decision, invalidation on edit; no execution permission.

components.label: Local session and event journal
components.description: Versioned local storage with drafts, committed proposals and ordered synthetic audit events; memory fallback and honest integrity limits.

components.label: Portable analyst handoff
components.description: Human-readable summary and documented JSON download containing findings, citations, reviewed proposal, gaps, audit and unexecuted verification/rollback instructions.

connections.label: Versioned synthetic evidence and control excerpts
Save draft and explicitly review committed revision
Import and analysis events with citations
Restore local draft and saved status
Evidence, proposal and full local event history
Current review state; not execution authority
